= camel get sanitizer

Get the violations the exchange sanitizer reported in running integrations (camel-sanitizer)


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel get sanitizer [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--duration` | How long to keep watching or following, in millis or as a duration such as 30s (default: until Enter is pressed) |  | long
| `--json` | Output in JSON Format |  | boolean
| `--report` | Show the report: the counts per rule and per kind, the commits followed, each violation with its threads and stacks, and the still pending warnings |  | boolean
| `--sort` | Sort by pid, name or age | pid | String
| `--watch` | Execute periodically and showing output fullscreen |  | boolean
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
|===
